hook_archetypes.name: The Kallaway Paradox / Subverted Assumption
hook_archetypes.formula: Everyone thinks [Common Belief about AI Topic]... but they are looking at the completely wrong thing. Here is what actually just happened.
hook_archetypes.visual_cue: High-contrast clinical split-screen or brooding A-roll talking head + dramatic sub-boom SFX
hook_archetypes.retention_mechanism: Cognitive dissonance. The viewer must watch to resolve the contradiction.

hook_archetypes.name: The Riley Brown Shock Outcome
hook_archetypes.formula: I just spent [Time/Effort] testing [New AI Feature]... and it did something that genuinely terrified/shocked me.
hook_archetypes.visual_cue: Instant full-screen screen recording showing an unbelievable output in the first 0.5 seconds
hook_archetypes.retention_mechanism: Immediate proof-of-work and extreme curiosity to see how it was done.

hook_archetypes.name: The Sabrina Ramonov Secret Architecture
hook_archetypes.formula: Do NOT use [Tool/Agent] until you understand this [Number]-step architecture. Most people are using it completely wrong.
hook_archetypes.visual_cue: Quick-flash (0.4s) of a complex node graph or blueprint + animated red warning/green solution boxes
hook_archetypes.retention_mechanism: FOMO and high bookmark utility. The viewer fears falling behind.

hook_archetypes.name: The Kallaway Context Lean & Pivot
hook_archetypes.formula: On [Date/Event], [Company/Product] made an announcement. Most people scrolled past it. But if you look under the hood... this rewires everything.
hook_archetypes.visual_cue: Fast pan over news headline/tweet, suddenly blurred out by a glowing 3D diagram overlay
hook_archetypes.retention_mechanism: Information asymmetry. Makes the viewer feel like they are getting insider intelligence.

hook_archetypes.name: The Riley Build-in-Public Race
hook_archetypes.formula: Can [AI Agent] actually [Achieve Massive Task] in under 60 seconds? Let's find out right now.
hook_archetypes.visual_cue: Stopwatch graphic in top right corner + keyboard typing SFX + live terminal output spinning

hook_archetypes.name: The Sabrina Unfair Leverage
hook_archetypes.formula: This single AI workflow does the work of an entire [Job Role]. Here is the exact prompt and system wiring.
hook_archetypes.visual_cue: Split screen: Traditional manual spreadsheet/dashboard vs. automated agent terminal spinning
hook_archetypes.retention_mechanism: Greed/Efficiency reflex. Viewer instantly wants the leverage for themselves.

hook_archetypes.name: The Trinity Hybrid Nuke (Brown x Kallaway x Ramonov)
hook_archetypes.formula: [Tech Giant] just quietly unlocked [Shocking Capability]. But wait—forget what the PR says. Here is the real blueprint, and here is what happens when you turn it on.
hook_archetypes.visual_cue: 0.0s: Heavy bass drop + text punch. 0.8s: Live screen demonstration. 1.8s: Blueprint zoom.
hook_archetypes.retention_mechanism: Tri-layer lock: Shock + Intel + Practical Blueprint all firing in under 2 seconds.
